Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class FaceSearchConfig

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.FaceSearchConfig
public final class FaceSearchConfig extends java.lang.Object
Exact-search settings. Scores are in [0,1] with the same meaning as 1:1 comparison. Null or empty filters mean unrestricted.
